name: Photo album
description: Play an album from FrameOS Photos through its share link, one photo per render, or show one photo of it.

fields.name: album
fields.label: Album link
fields.hint: Make one with Install photo scenes on the Photos page.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: One photo
fields.hint: The path of one photo inside the album, to show it alone. Leave empty to play the album.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: random shows every photo once before any repeats. sequential goes by folder and file name, newest and oldest by date.

fields.name: counterStateKey
fields.label: State field for the position
fields.hint: The scene needs an integer state field with this name, saved to disk, so the album keeps its place after a restart or a deep sleep. Leave empty to pick a random photo each time.
